confidence_notes: Recent Ulaanbaatar cost-of-living aggregates support the restaurant, coffee and beer estimates. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated from the local beer-price relationship; accommodation is a broad July-season model estimate without current listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: No outside-city comparison used. Food and drink estimates rely on Ulaanbaatar-specific aggregated prices; accommodation reflects broad knowledge of hostel, guesthouse and budget-hotel costs in regional capitals.
